details.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$rows=@(); Get-ChildItem .coding-tools/orchestration/reports -Directory -Filter 'run-*' | ForEach-Object { $p=Join-Path $_.FullName 'run-summary.md'; if(Test-Path $p){$i=Get-Item $p; if($i.LastWriteTimeUtc -ge [datetime]'2026-09-15T01:30:00Z'){ $rows += [pscustomobject]@{run=$_.Name.Substring(4);mtime=$i.LastWriteTimeUtc.ToString('o')} }}}; $rows|Sort-Object mtime|ConvertTo-Json -Compress"
